If you missed it earlier, I posted a video about how computer code works and why I think you are more than capable of understanding software!

www.youtube.com/watch?v=egZJ...
I need way more Detroit style pizza in way more places

New Technology Boy video!

I think you can code, and I don't think you need an AI to help you do so. If you've never even *thought* about computer code or programming before, I'd bet you're still able to follow along and maybe even do a little exploration of yer own

www.youtube.com/watch?v=egZJ...

Well, I’m actively trying to upload a video right now but it seems that YouTube is shitting the bed, as it oft does

Hoping things will get cleared up in time to still post later today. Apparently there’s "issues with uploading videos" — SEEMS BAD?
Editing a video to go up hopefully tomorrow! Here's a helpful preview

AND IM PROUD TO BE AN AMERICAN

WHERE AT LEAST I KNOW IM FREE

AND I WONT FORGET THE MEN WHO DIED

TO BRING WI-FI TO ME

www.reuters.com/sustainabili...
It’s just states rights, yknow?
Nah, see, that's actually a *small government* approach to putting unaccountable, militarized federal agents in civilian airports across the country on top of the existing security theater
It's been a rough go of it as someone who exclusively uses gasoline in my toilet tanks

As we continue on our journey with this administration trying to roll back voting rights, a reminder that the “SAVE Act” is absolutely not a “voter ID law,” and reading the bill makes that abundantly clear 

I made a video about it a few weeks back with more info:

www.youtube.com/watch?v=6LgJ...
ICE agents not being able to wear their masks in airports after being arbitrarily dispatched as a political move is actually a very funny turn of events

Just a reminder that there’s no Stuff Keeps Happening episode today, despite receiving reports of stuff happening.

SKH will be back next week and I’ll have a video up later this week 👍
Also to be clear: you can do both simultaneously and it does count as double points yea
The fun part is you’ll never know how wrong you are

Living in the US of A means having the luxury of playing a fun game of "guess if there's more people concealed carrying or not wearing underwear around me" whenever you're in public

Like

The grocery store
Today was very pretty outside though and I had a bagel on a shaded patio

Watching an old man attempt to do wartime  dictation by tweet is just not where I hoped we'd be at this stage of my life

Thankfully, the economy is also terrible
A few clips from episode 3 of my Satisfactory let's play! What if we kissed in the shadow of Stank Mountain? #gaming #satisfactory #letsplay #endeavorance

March 16 2026 | I am but a record spinning endlessly as a needle traces my looping fractures, doomed to haunt the cold metal diaphragm of a phonograph with the unheeded ramblings of a man long since lost. Or something like that idk. #news #politics #unitedstates #stuffkeepshappening #endeavorance
March 12 2026 | More like OpenA-BYE #news #ai #technology #stuffkeepshappening

A few more highlights from the second episode of my Satisfactory lets play! I've got about 150 hours in a save file on my PS5 but I'm making a new factory from scratch on PC for this series. It's going... well, it's going. #gaming #satisfactory #letsplay #endeavorance
Clips from the second installment of my new Satisfactory let's play series 🚧 #gaming #satisfactory #letsplay #endeavorance #funny
